name: pick-rays
notes: Rays against the side-2 box fixture (box.json). Face order: bottom 0, top 1, front(-Y) 2, back(+Y) 3, left(-X) 4, right(+X) 5. Top face loop is [4, 5, 6, 7]; vertex 6 is (1, 1, 1). vertex_tolerance / edge_tolerance are the DirectEditOptions pick tolerances for that ray; absent means the defaults (0.25 / 0.5).
